description: Exterior natural sandstone wall tile from Pak Clay's stone cladding range, made for house fronts, boundary walls and feature panels. Natural sandstone typically has an earthy, textured face in warm sand tones, and each piece varies slightly, which gives a wall a hand-finished look. Heavier than clay or ceramic, it should be fixed with a suitable adhesive on a sound wall. Message us on WhatsApp for a free sample to judge colour and texture in daylight, then ask for a dated written quote with your wall area and city.

Outdoor natural sandstone tile for patios, garden paths, porches and terraces. Sandstone is a natural stone with a textured surface that tends to give better grip underfoot than a polished finish, and its sand tones suit Pakistani sun and garden settings. Each piece varies in shade, so order your full quantity together. Lay on a drained, compacted base with a slight fall. Request a free sample on WhatsApp to see the colour and surface, and send your area and city for a dated written quote.

Cobbler paver tile in a 4x4 inch format from Pak Clay, a small square piece for outdoor paving. The compact size follows curves, borders and paths easily and gives a traditional cobbled look to porches, driveways and garden areas. Small pavers rely on a well-compacted base and tight joints, so plan the bedding before you buy. For vehicle areas, confirm thickness and suitability with us first. Ask for a free sample on WhatsApp and send your area, use and city for a dated written quote.

Grass grid paver tile from Pak Clay, an open-cell paving piece that lets grass grow through the openings while the grid holds the surface. It is commonly used for driveways, parking bays and garden access paths where a greener look and water drainage are wanted instead of solid paving. A compacted, well-drained base is important, and suitability depends on the load, so tell us how the area will be used. Request a free sample on WhatsApp and send your area and city for a dated written quote.
